item.text: {"question_id":"8B.6","answer":"Implementation was substantial but uneven. Observable practice included a 20% statutory minimum-wage increase effective January 2023 (BATCH-0031-E008), a federally mandated 2023 IMSS-BIENESTAR operating framework for free health services, medicines, and supplies (BATCH-0051-E001), expanded budgets for priority programs including the older-adult pension, and documented program delivery through government-partner initiatives involving employment, training, refugee integration, institutional capacity, and public responses (BATCH-0052-E001; BATCH-0015-E013; BATCH-0015-E016; BATCH-0015-E017). The Maya Train was opened for partial service and military-controlled infrastructure and operating entities functioned in practice, but the train had hours-long delays, unfinished track, major cost escalation, and uncertain operating-cost recovery (BATCH-0030-E004; BATCH-0029-E007). Implementation quality and observability were materially weakened by design and monitoring gaps: three of sixteen priority programs lacked clear target populations, four were categorized as management and did not measure results, eight required stronger or adequate result measurement, logical association was absent in two programs, recommendations had been disregarded to varying degrees, and Sembrando Vida and the health/medicines program lacked coverage indicators; the latest coverage data were chiefly for 2022, with four programs below planned coverage (BATCH-0052-E002; BATCH-0052-E004; BATCH-0052-E005; BATCH-0052-E006). Health access had deteriorated from 2018 to 2022 amid institutional transition, while the centralized medicine warehouse was inaugurated without evidence in the supplied passage that it achieved reliable nationwide delivery (BATCH-0032-E003; BATCH-0013-E006). Audits and monitoring also identified undocumented or irregular expenditures, weak procurement competition and transparency, and unresolved Tren Maya property and transfer documentation (BATCH-0011-E001; BATCH-0042-E008; BATCH-0040-E008). Thus, plans and directives clearly became real programs, services, projects, and institutional activity in several domains, but the supplied evidence does not establish consistently effective, lawful, high-quality, or nationally complete execution. Attribution is strongest to the federal administration and its agencies, not always personally to López Obrador; partner, subnational, inherited, and agency-level contributions remain material. Moral effects are outside this execution question and did not alter the
